text:
[issue by ReedJr]
### Minecraft Version

1.20.1

### What happened?

This has been reported to the Reforged dev team. I just want to make sure that this is not an issue on your end. 

**How to copy this issue:**
**1.** Run the most recent version of 1.20.1 of the following mods:
* [Reforged (formerly Tiered)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tiered)
* [Curios API (Forge/NeoForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios)
* [UnionLib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/unionlibl)

**2.** Run Minecraft I with the said mods with your pilfered launcher. I tested this with Curseforge. 
after you do these steps you should get an error message form the crash report.

Reported issue on Reforged dev team side: [https://github.com/Stereowalker/Reforged/issues/129](https://github.com/Stereowalker/Reforged/issues/129)

my most resent crash report:
[https://pastebin.com/6Q160ASK](https://pastebin.com/6Q160ASK)

### Relevant Log Outputs

_No response_
